actions.reason: C0004 has coherent biological support from RNA (7 significant pathways, including pancreas beta cells) and CNV (4 significant continuous features on chr7 and chr20), with a nominal PBRM1 mutation trend. Cross-modal consistency shows positive WSI and RNA silhouettes, high patient support (median 2, 5.3% all-positive), and good internal structure (ARI 0.734, consensus separation 0.776). Technical confounders are not significant at set level. This set has defensible identity with corroboration from multiple distinct sources.

C0001 has RNA-only support (15 pathways) but no significant WXS or CNV findings, and cross-modal consistency is weak (all silhouettes near zero, 4/14 patients with zero support). No supported split or merge exists, and no available extra evidence can resolve the gap. The evidence is insufficient for a defensible identity.

No supported split or merge exists, and no available extra evidence can resolve the gap. The evidence is insufficient for a defensible identity.
